q2_gaps: ordinal day-of-year dating in a non-Gregorian calendar ("On day 301 of Year 1") — the Time term inventory (Year/Month/Day/Weekday) is specified against month-day calendar expressions and gives no reading for a day numbered within a year, so (Day 301) is used outside its defined range

episodic negative existential over a bare kind ("No wraith approached the Lantern that night") — the strength-0 distributing rule is specified only for a generic habit ("Ns don't V") or a definite set's blanket denial ("none of the Ns"), not for a one-off dated non-occurrence
notes: Per-member distribution rules are added for "the keepers carried" (24) and "the keepers drew" (53) but not for the equally plural "the ground feathers warded" (99-103); the instruction set leaves distributive-vs-collective to judgment here, so this is a consistency wobble rather than a rule violation. The participial premodifiers in "the stored mire-essence" and "the ground feathers" get no atom of their own, but coreference to the already-asserted store/grind events pins the referent, so nothing is widened.
